description_en: Queries the available existing certificates for a specified domain name, that is, certificates that are already managed in SSL Certificates Service
description_zh: 获取指定域名可选的已有证书，即已在SSL证书中进行管理的证书
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-certificates --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCertificates

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to query the associated SSL certificates.

If you do not set this parameter, the SSL certificates associated with all domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询关联SSL证书的域名。

不设置该参数表示查询所有域名关联的SSL证书
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

Certificates.description_en: The SSL certificate information associated with the domain name

CommonName.description_en: The domain name that is bound to the certificate

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The value is a Unix timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 证书到期时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒

IsUsing.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is currently used by the domain name. Valid values:

true: The certificate is in use.
false: The certificate is not in use
IsUsing.description_zh:
是否是该域名当前所使用的证书。取值：

true：表示是。
false：表示否

Sans.description_en: The list of SAN (Subject Alternative Name) extension attributes of the certificate

items.description_en: Other domain names that are bound to the certificate
